summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 targeted fixes (Coaching single CTA, Membership $75→$90, PeriodPills horizontal scroll). Coaching and Membership fixes PASS fully. However, the PeriodPills ScrollView wrap introduced a HIGH-severity visual regression on every screen that uses PeriodPills: because `pill` has `flex:1` and it is now inside a horizontal ScrollView with unbounded main-axis width, each pill collapses to a very small width (18–33 px) and the pill text overlaps / clips. Confirmed on Budget (months 18.8px wide), Transactions (All/Income/Expenses ~32.8px — 'Income' text overflows onto 'Expenses'), Net Worth (Month/Quarter/Year ~30.8px), Settings (Faith/Both/Motivation and Light/System/Dark visibly overlap), and Legacy (pills ~22.8px, Retirement label truncated to 'R…'). Regression checks on Home bell, More screen, powered-by-jaleter footer all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: After wrapping the pill row in a horizontal ScrollView, each pill collapses because `pill: { flex: 1 }` (index.tsx:3550) tries to distribute nonexistent bounded width. Result: pills are 18–33 px wide, labels overlap and are truncated across Budget (`budget-period-*` ~18.8px), Transactions (`tx-filter-*` ~32.8px — 'Income'/'Expenses' overlap), Net Worth (`nw-period-*` ~30.8px — 'Month'/'Quarter'/'Year' overlap), Settings (`settings-exp-*`, `settings-appear-*` overlap), Legacy (`legacy-period-*` ~22.8px, 'Retirement' truncated to 'R…'). Fix: remove `flex:1` from `pill` and rely on horizontal padding/gap, or add a `minWidth` (~64) to `pill`, or apply `alignSelf:'flex-start'` on the inner `s.segmented` View plus intrinsic-width pills.

action_items: Fix PeriodPills styling: since it now lives inside a horizontal ScrollView, remove `flex:1` from `s.pill` (or make the pill sizing intrinsic). Suggested minimal fix: change `pill: { flex: 1, ... }` → `pill: { paddingHorizontal: 14, minWidth: 64, ... }` and add `alignSelf: 'flex-start'` on the inner `s.segmented` View so it hugs content instead of stretching the outer scroll width. Re-verify Budget/Transactions/Net Worth/Settings/Legacy after fix.

Optionally: Only wrap PeriodPills in a ScrollView when the number of `values` exceeds a threshold (e.g. > 5) so shorter lists still stretch to fill the row like before, preserving the original visual for Budget/Tx/NW/Settings.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: `PeriodPills` (index.tsx:336) now renders its inner segmented View inside a horizontal `ScrollView`. React Native's horizontal ScrollView gives its content an unbounded main-axis size, so children with `flex:1` (index.tsx:3550 `s.pill`) end up with a flex-basis of 0 and no additional space to distribute — every pill collapses to `paddingHorizontal` alone. Fix by using intrinsic pill widths (padding + optional minWidth) and letting the segmented View hug content via `alignSelf:'flex-start'`. Verified impact by measuring bounding boxes: Budget months=18.8px, tx-filter=32.8px, nw-period=30.8px, legacy=22.8px — vs the previous ~1/N of the screen width.
